SELECT DISTINCT
  w.name as ward_name,
  w.latitude,
  w.longitude,
  d.name as district_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) as farm_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fr.user_id) as farmer_count
FROM wards w
JOIN districts d ON w.district_id = d.id
JOIN farms f ON f.ward_id = w.id
JOIN farmers fr ON f.farmer_id = fr.id
WHERE w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.latitude, w.longitude, d.name
ORDER BY farm_count DESC;

=INSERT INTO alerts (alert_type, severity, title, message, valid_from, valid_until, is_active, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.alert_type}}',
  '{{$json.severity}}',
  '{{$json.title}}',
  '{{$json.message}}',
  '{{$json.valid_from}}',
  '{{$json.valid_until}}',
  {{$json.is_active}},
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

=-- Get farmers affected by this weather alert
WITH affected_farmers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fr.user_id
  FROM farmers fr
  JOIN farms f ON f.farmer_id = fr.id
  JOIN wards w ON f.ward_id = w.id
  JOIN districts d ON w.district_id = d.id
  WHERE w.name = '{{$node["Analyze Weather"].json.ward_name}}'
    AND d.name = '{{$node["Analyze Weather"].json.district_name}}'
)
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, alert_id, channel, status, sent_at)
SELECT 
  user_id,
  {{$node["Create Alert"].json.id}},
  'system',
  'sent',
  NOW()
FROM affected_farmers
RETURNING id, user_id;
